achievement.1.description: Siz shubhali joylarni ko'rasiz va boshqa odamlarning kundaliklarini, ayniqsa vampirlar haqidagi hikoyalarni o'qishni yaxshi ko'rasiz. Siz shuningdek, tokenlarni to‘plovchi va tadqiqotchisiz. Hurmat!
achievement.1.name: [EN] Castlemania
achievement.10.description: Siz orzular va mas'uliyat yo'lidan o'zingizni o'ylaydigan kuchsiz yurasiz. Ochko'zlik va xudbinlikdan ozod bo'lib, siz boshqalarga mukofot kutmasdan yordam berasiz.
achievement.10.name: [EN] Nightmare Knight
achievement.100.description: Tuzoqqa tushib qolgan va yirtilgan jonzotning vahshiy g'azabiga kam narsa tengdir. Siz munosib raqib bo'ldingiz.
achievement.100.name: Irahsaning qotili
achievement.101.description: Ko'r-ko'rona nafrat jismoniy shaklga ega bo'lib, u tug'ilgan adolatsizlikka qarshi zo'ravonlik bilan isyon ko'rsatdi. Siz adolat keltira olmadingiz - lekin hech bo'lmaganda vaqtinchalik tinchlik.
achievement.101.name: Frodomo qotili
achievement.102.description: Aeonlarning taqiqlangan bilimlari hech qachon bu dunyoni bosib olish uchun mo'ljallanmagan. Siz uning ovozini eshitmasdan oldin o'chirdingiz.
achievement.102.name: Teneshpar qotili
achievement.103.description: Siz Devovorganing xavfli chodirlarini va uning katta pillasini tushirishga yordam berdingiz - uning o'zgarishini to'xtatmasdan, oxir-oqibat uning o'limi uchun muhim qadamni yakunladingiz.
achievement.103.name: Qiyomat pillasi
achievement.104.description: Ko'pchilik orasida alohida qahramon. Bu yil - bu siz edingiz. Devovorga sizning va o'rtoqlaringizning kuchiga dosh bera olmagani uchun qorong'i dunyoga chekindi. Sizning tanlovingiz to'g'ri yoki yo'qligini vaqt ko'rsatadi, ammo hozircha u sizning dunyongizni saqlab qoldi.
achievement.104.name: [EN] Devovorga's Nemesis
achievement.105.description: Charchagan... juda charchagan... issiq va shinam to'shakda jingalak bo'lish hozir eng zo'r narsaga o'xshaydi. Shirin tushlar!
achievement.105.name: [EN] Mister Sandman
achievement.106.description: Uxlash - siz buni uslub bilan qilasiz. Hamakda sovqotib, qushlar va chigirtkalarning ovoziga quloq solib, asta-sekin orzular olamiga borasan.
achievement.106.name: Meni uyquga silkit
achievement.107.description: Qulay uxlash uchun sizga ko'p narsa kerak emas. Bir dasta somon va boshingizga tom yopish - bu butunlay ixtiyoriy - dam olish uchun etarli. Kalamushlarning oyoq barmoqlarini tishlashiga ham qarshi emassiz.
achievement.107.name: Kamtar mehmon
achievement.108.description: Xo'sh, bu sovg'aning mazmuni siz kutgandek emas edi. Bunday do'stlar bilan kimga dushman kerak?
achievement.108.name: Sizda hazil
achievement.109.description: Sizning tukli do'stingiz uchun juda ko'p! Balki qush qafasi oldida turib, uning bo‘ynini qisib, “Qo‘shiq ayt! Qo'shiq ayt! Qo‘shiq ayting!” buning uchun bir oz ko'p edi ?!
achievement.109.name: Voy
achievement.11.description: Siz o'lmagan suyak aka-ukalariga qo'shildingiz - o'limni dushmaningiz va qurolingizga aylantirdingiz. Kuchsiz narsani yutib yuborish va kuchliga joy qoldirish sizning asosiy maqsadingizdir.
achievement.11.name: Suyak aka
achievement.110.description: Siz ovchilar va terimchilar hayotini yashaysiz. Xo'sh, ayniqsa, terimchi va ayniqsa, ko'p ko'k mevalarni yig'adigan kishi. Yaqinda tilingiz rangini tekshirdingizmi?
achievement.110.name: Bluebarian
achievement.111.description: Qalin, qizil - chayqalgan, aralashtirilmagan - va unda somon bilan: bu sizning jin qoningizni afzal ko'rgan yo'l. Piyoz halqasi bilan xizmat qilganda, nozik metall ta'mi deyarli sezilmaydi. Salomatlik yoki mana uchun foydali ta'sirlar mamnuniyat bilan qabul qilinadi.
achievement.111.name: Demonik Barkeeper
achievement.112.description: Siz qishni yaxshi ko'rasiz. Sharf va qo'lqoplar bilan to'liq jihozlangan, siz do'stlaringiz bilan ko'plab qordan odamlarni qurishda tashqarida dam olishni yoqtirasiz. Qor to'pi bilan kurash, kimdir?
achievement.112.name: Qordan odam
achievement.113.name: Hayvonning soni
achievement.114.description: Siz va to'ldirilgan mo'ynali do'stlaringiz ajralmassiz va ularni o'zingiz bilan to'shakka olib borishdan uyalmaysiz - kim biladi, qachon tun yarmida quchoqqa muhtoj bo'lib uyg'onasiz?
achievement.114.name: Meni quchoqlang
achievement.115.description: Mayli, tan olaylik, agar u sizni eng katta xazinaga olib borishi mumkinligiga ishonsangiz, u qanchalik baliqli ko'rinmasin, bu xaritani qo'yib yubormaysiz. Bularning barchasi zamirida qandaydir sir bo'lsa kerak!
achievement.115.name: Engil imkoniyat
achievement.116.description: Yoki siz tez o'rganuvchi emassiz yoki o'zingizga o't qo'yishdan zavqlanasiz. Yoki siz shunchaki chiroyli sarlavha qidiryapsiz. Qanday bo'lmasin, shuni bilishingiz kerakki, kichik eshak tajribalari paytida gaz o'tkazish tavsiya etilmaydi.
achievement.116.name: Cho'ntakdagi raketa
achievement.117.description: Lekin ko'zingizni yuming va hech kimga nima orzu qilganingizni aytmang, aks holda u amalga oshmaydi!
achievement.117.name: Tilagingizni tilang
achievement.118.description: Rojdestvo - bu yilning eng sevimli vaqti va bola, siz sovg'alarni yaxshi ko'rasizmi? Do'stlaringiz uchun yoqimli narsalarni sotib oling, ularni o'zingiz ochishga qaror qilguningizcha yashiring.
achievement.118.name: Santaning Li'l yordamchisi
achievement.119.description: Zararli spawnning g'azabi - siz tasodifan unga duchor bo'ldingiz. Sizning kunlaringiz sanaladi va o'limingiz muqarrar. Vaqti-vaqti bilan. Bir joyda.
achievement.119.name: Cursed!
achievement.12.description: Siz deyarli ma'nosiz ibodat uchun dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qildingiz - lekin hech bo'lmaganda buni takrorlashingiz shart emas va ko'z ochib yumguncha yangi muborak qoziqni olishingiz mumkin.
achievement.12.name: Muborak!
achievement.120.description: Vajjaj! Topuvchilar qo'riqchilar, yutqazganlar yig'laydilar! Bularning hammasi qayerdan kelgani va uni olish uchun axlat uyumlarini aylanib o'tishga to'g'ri kelsa, kimga qiziq? Bu BEPUL!
achievement.120.name: Bepul mahsulotlar!
achievement.121.description: Yuqoriga va pastga va yuqoriga va pastga ... va keyin katta halqa! Kutib turing - ular Kazordoonda looplar qurmaydilar. Ammo ma'danli vagonda yurish hali ham qiziqarli!
achievement.121.name: [EN] Rollercoaster
achievement.122.description: Siz, ser yoki xonim, haqiqiy alkimyogarsiz. Har bir mumkin bo'lgan kombinatsiyani topish uchun transmutatsion eksperimentlarni o'tkazish ko'p yillar davomida sizning yashirin ishtiyoqingiz bo'lib kelgan va tadqiqotingiz natijalari aql bovar qilmaydi. Siz tufayli ilm-fan sakrashga erishdi!
achievement.122.name: [EN] Transmutator
achievement.123.description: RAWR! Tanangizda kuch yuguradi, yuragingiz tezroq yuguradi va har bir qurolingiz tebranishini adrenalin bilan to'ldiradi. Hammasi kichik shishada. Buzilgan mebel uchun pul qaytarib berilmaydi. Qo'shimcha savollar uchun davolovchi yoki iksir sotuvchisiga murojaat qiling.
achievement.123.name: Berserker
achievement.124.description: Siz eng qiyin topishmoqlarni bir daqiqa ichida hal qilishingiz mumkinligini his qilasiz. Bundan tashqari, afsunga zarar yetkazish uchun yaxshi kuch bor. Hammasi kichik shishada. Keyingi ta'sirlar - biroz ahmoqlik. Qo'shimcha savollar uchun davolovchi yoki iksir sotuvchisiga murojaat qiling.
achievement.124.name: Boshlovchi
achievement.125.description: Yaxshilangan ko'rish qobiliyati, yorug'lik tezligida uchadigan o'qlar va murvatlar va dushmanlaringizni qo'shimcha zarar bilan bog'lash. Hammasi kichik shishada. Sabzi iste'mol qilish shart emas. Qo'shimcha savollar uchun davolovchi yoki iksir sotuvchisiga murojaat qiling.
achievement.125.name: [EN] Sharpshooter
achievement.126.description: Urgh! Derazalarni yoping! Xunuk sarg'ish boshini ko'targan quyoshni o'chiring, qo'shningizning baquvvat bolalarining quloqlarini yirtuvchi kulgilarini yoping. Ahhh. Shirin zulmat va sukunatni quchoqlang.
achievement.126.name: Bezovta qilinmasin
achievement.127.description: Ko'taring va porlang! Bu ajoyib yangi kun - derazalaringizni oching, quyoshning iliq nurini his qiling, derazangizda qushlarning sayrashini tomosha qiling va o'simliklaringizga g'amxo'rlik qiling. Baxtli bo'lmaslik uchun qanday sabab bor?
achievement.127.name: Quyosh nuri kirsin
achievement.128.description: Argh! Hozir emas! Qanday qilib bu ko'p funktsiyali asboblardan sharbat siqish kabi arzimas narsa uchun foydalansangiz, hech qachon ishlamay qoladi, lekin sizni quvib kelayotgan olovli ajdaho bilan arqonga ko'tarilishingiz kerak bo'lganda, chalkash bo'ladi?
achievement.128.name: Yomon vaqt
achievement.129.description: Siz baland o'tlarda yoki shoshqaloq yog'ochda qolib ketgan tayyorlanmagan sarguzashtchilarga kulasiz. Yoki siz haqiqatan ham ularga yordam berasiz. Ular sizni... “Machete” deyishadi.
achievement.129.name: Meni hech narsa to'xtata olmaydi
achievement.13.description: Siz iste'dodli savdogarsiz, u mahsulotlarga ehtiyotkorlik bilan munosabatda bo'lasiz, yaxshi takliflarni topasiz va vaqti-vaqti bilan noyob narsalarni topasiz. Buyurtmani bajarish uchun hech qachon kechikmang, siz ishonchli savdogarsiz - hech bo'lmaganda Rashidning nazarida.
achievement.13.name: Taniqli savdogar
achievement.130.description: O‘roq yelkangizdan o‘tdi, yelkangizda quyosh yondi – siz dehqonsiz va dalada ishlashni yaxshi ko‘rasiz. Yoki yana, ehtimol siz hamkasblaringizni qo'rqitish uchun shunchaki ajoyib ekin doiralarini yaratasiz.
achievement.130.name: Baxtli fermer
achievement.131.description: Ozodlik ko‘rfazi siz uchun eng zo‘r dam olish maskani bo‘lib, shakarqamish yig‘ish bo‘sh vaqtni o‘tkazish uchun juda qulaydir. Shakaringiz bilan choy ichmoqchimisiz, jonim?
achievement.131.name: Tabiiy tatlandırıcı
achievement.132.description: Yo-ho-ho va bir shisha rom - uyda pishirilgan, albatta, qo'lda terilgan va shaxsan o'rim-yig'im qilingan shakarqamish o'simliklaridan tayyorlanadi. Endi, uni eman bochkasida qaritib qo'ying va taxminan 10 yil ichida undan zavqlaning. Yoki sabrsizlar uchun: Keling, hozir paaaarty qilaylik!
achievement.132.name: Homebrewed
achievement.133.description: Cho'lning qumtepalari ostida yashirin xazinalar - ularni topish uchun burningiz bor va siz qaerda qazishni bilasiz. Ular sizni iflos qilib boy qilmasligi mumkin, lekin baribir ular yorqin va chiroyli.
achievement.133.name: Oltin qazuvchi
achievement.134.description: Siz va sizning belkurak - osmonda qilingan gugurt. Yoki jahannam, buning uchun. Har qanday holatda ham pastda. Sizni tosh qoziqlar sehrli tarzda o'ziga jalb qiladi va ularni ochishni va bu teshiklar sizni qayerga olib borishini ko'rishni yaxshi ko'radi. Yaxshi biceps ham.
achievement.134.name: [EN] The Undertaker
achievement.135.description: Sizni har kim osonlikcha topishi mumkin, agar ular shunchaki cookie-fayllarni maydalash iziga ergashsa. Siz uchun esa haqiqiy sevgi oxirgi kukini berishni anglatadi.
achievement.135.name: [EN] Cookie Monster
achievement.136.description: Va har kim boshqacha da'vo qilsa, yolg'onchidir.
achievement.136.name: Kek - bu haqiqat
achievement.137.description: Mashhur "Eritilgan shokoladli tort" ni siz yozgan bo'lsangiz kerak. Yomg'irli tushdan keyin mo'ri oldida, adyolga o'ralgan holda kakao lazzatlari bilan mashg'ul bo'lish xuddi shunday tuyuladi. Rohatlaning!
achievement.137.name: Shirin tish
achievement.138.description: Sizga yumshoq, mevali bo'laklari va shirin shakarli pirojnoe yoqadi. Va siz ularni o'zingiz qilishni afzal ko'rasiz. Nonvoyxona ochish haqida hech o‘ylab ko‘rganmisiz? Siz hozir juda yaxshi bo'lishingiz kerak!
achievement.138.name: Tepasida olcha bilan
achievement.139.description: Muahahaha bu... mutatsiyaga uchragan qovoq! Uni tushirishga yordam berganingizdan so'ng - siz yordam berdingiz, shunday emasmi? - siz o'z mukofotingizni talab qildingiz va ozmi-ko'pmi g'alati sovg'a oldingiz. Xellouin bayrami bilan!
achievement.139.name: [EN] Mutated Presents
achievement.14.description: Hayot bulog‘idan topib, bir ho‘plading. Bu sizga abadiy hayot bermadi deb o'yladim, o'zingizni o'zgargan va qandaydir xotirjam his qilasiz.
achievement.14.name: Hayot favvorasi
achievement.140.description: Nur tashuvchilardan biri. Havzalarning yonib turishiga yordam bergan va zulmatga qarshi birgalikda harakat qilganlardan biri. Olamlar orasidagi yupqa parda ortida jin shivirlaydi - sizning yordamingiz tufayli ular yana jim bo'ldi.
achievement.140.name: Olov qo'riqchisi
achievement.141.description: Siz eng sadoqatli nur tashuvchilardan birisiz - sizsiz jinlar olamlar orasidagi pardani yirtib tashlagan bo'lar edi. Siz har bir havzani yoqib, baland va past sayohat qilib, boshqa dunyo kuchlarini orqaga surdingiz. Nur bo'lsin!
achievement.141.name: Haqiqiy nur tashuvchisi
achievement.142.description: Siz ilon xudosining mujassamlanishini mag'lub qildingiz va ilon tayoqining so'nggi kuchli tebranishi bilan uning hayotiy kuchini to'xtatdingiz. Hokimiyat, hiyla-nayrang va korruptsiya hikoyasi nihoyasiga yetdi - yoki... yo'qmi?
achievement.142.name: Godslayer
achievement.143.description: Uh... yaqinda uyg'ongan odam kim? Yerda singan kokteyl stakanlari, butun xonada gullar va nega uzuk taqqansiz? Kecha uzoq va g'alati kun bo'lsa kerak...
achievement.143.name: Keyingi kun
achievement.144.description: Uzoq muddatli munosabatlar faqat siz uchun emas. Va har safar o'zingizni sevib qolgan deb o'ylaganingizda, ko'p o'tmay noto'g'ri ekanligingiz isbotlangan. Yoki, ehtimol, siz har safar noto'g'ri sevgiliga duch kelishingiz mumkin - ekspluatatsiya qilinadi va xiyonat qiladi. Yolg'iz qolish yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin.
achievement.144.name: Majburiyat fobisi
achievement.145.description: Ishonchi? Sevgimi? Sodiqlikmi? Pah! Qadimgi tuyg'ular. Siz zavqlanar ekansiz, ko'p yuraklarga qadam qo'yishga qarshi emassiz. Tercihen jangovar etik kiyganda.
achievement.145.name: Yurak buzuvchi
achievement.146.description: Yashirin o'ldirish va orqadan pichoqlash sizning mutaxassisligingizdir. Sizning ko'p qurbonlaringiz odatda o'zlarining yaqin o'limlarini bilishmaydi, siz ularga indamay va tez olib kelasiz. Hamma narsaga ruxsat berilgan.
achievement.146.name: Tez o'lim
achievement.147.description: Hayotda eng yaxshisi nima? Dushmanlaringizni yo'q qilish uchun. Ularni sizning oldingizda haydashini ko'rish uchun. Va keyin bir piyola choy ichish uchun.
achievement.147.name: Shafqatsiz xushmuomalalik
achievement.148.description: Siz tilanchisiz, uysiz, harom va yirtiq kiyimdasiz. Ammo bu siz hech kimdan biror narsa so'rashingiz kerak degani emas - va siz hali ham mag'rurligingizni saqlab qolasiz. Yupqa patlar yaxshi qushlarni yaratishi shart emas - ularning ostida nima borligi muhimroqdir.
achievement.148.name: Ko'chalardagi hayot
achievement.149.description: Suyaklar Birodarligining nishonlari va qora liboslarini kiyib, siz qo'rquv va og'riqni tarqatib, yaqinda paydo bo'ladigan nekromantik armiya uchun yangi askarlarni yaratib, erlarni kezasiz. Birodarlikka salom.
achievement.149.name: Bosh suyagi va suyaklari
achievement.15.description: Siz elementar sferalarning syurreal olami bo'ylab sayohat qildingiz, neytral materiyani olish uchun elementlarning Rabbini chaqirdingiz va o'ldirdingiz. Qanchalik jasur bo'lsangiz ham, jamoangizsiz buni uddalay olmas edingiz!
achievement.15.name: Elementlarning Rabbi
achievement.150.description: Siz dahshatli tushlardan qo'rqmaysiz, ularda sayohat qilasiz - son-sanoqsiz dahshatlarga duch kelasiz va ular olib keladigan taqdirga qarshi kurashasiz. O'sha tushlaringizdan olib keladigan qorong'u bashoratlaringizga ko'pchilik ishonadi, lekin siz bilan birga Nightmare Knights sifatida kurashadiganlar.
achievement.150.name: [EN] Nightmare Walker
achievement.151.description: Har bir shahar sizga o'xshagan odamni o'z aholisi deyishdan faxrlanishi kerak. Siz ko'chalarni toza tutasiz va depo oldidagi odatiy nizolarni hal qilishga yordam berasiz. Bundan tashqari, sizda mushuk bor va piyoda sayr qilishni yoqtirasiz.
achievement.151.name: Namunali fuqaro
achievement.152.description: Siz bu qoziqni faqat bezak uchun olib yurmaysiz - siz undan foydalanishga tayyormiz. Odatda sizni eng chuqur zindonlarda o'ldirilgan jinlar izidan o'tib ketayotganingizni ko'rasiz. Kim sizning yo'lingizda turishga jur'at etsa, o'limga tayyorlansin.
achievement.152.name: Demonbane
achievement.153.description: Biri tabiat bilan, biri yovvoyi tabiat bilan. Xom va hayvoniy kuch, o'tkir hislar, eng baland qoyalarda uvillash va eng qalin o'rmonlarda bo'kirish - bu sizsiz.
achievement.153.name: Bo'rilar va ayiqlar haqida
achievement.154.description: Kunduzi sizni kamuflyajlangan holda o'rmonda tuzoq qo'ygan yoki katta ovni quvgan holda topishingiz mumkin, kechasi siz gulxan yonida o'tirib, ov haqidagi hikoyalaringizni baham ko'rasiz. Ovlaganingni yeb, terisini yeganingni kiyasan. Hayot shunday abadiy davom etishi mumkin edi.
achievement.154.name: Uslub bilan ov qilish
achievement.155.description: Va esda tuting: hech qachon cho'chqaga qo'shiq aytishga o'rgatishga urinmang. Bu sizning vaqtingizni behuda sarflaydi va cho'chqani bezovta qiladi.
achievement.155.name: Yurakdagi ahmoq
achievement.156.description: Kenarli pichoq va mustahkam to'liq plastinka zirh bilan jihozlangan bo'lib, siz dushmanlaringizga kuch va jasorat bilan hujum qilasiz. Siz uchun har doim qutqaradigan qiz va o'ldirish uchun ajdaho bor.
achievement.156.name: Yorqin zirhda
achievement.157.description: Siz kuningizni oltin qozoningizda cho'milishdan boshlaysiz va eng yaxshi kiyimingizda ko'chalarda sayr qilib, boyligingizni ko'rsatishga qarshi emassiz - axir bu sizning mashaqqatli pulingiz! Siz "Janob hazratlari" deb murojaat qilishni afzal ko'rasiz.
achievement.157.name: Aristokrat
achievement.158.description: Qor uyumlari va do‘l sizni bormoqchi bo‘lgan joyingizdan to‘xtata olmaydi. Siz abadiy muzga har qanday ekspeditsiya uchun mukammal jihozlangansiz va oyoqlaringizni qanday isitishni bilasiz. Agar siz ayol bo'lsangiz, bu ham katta muvaffaqiyat.
achievement.158.name: Qor bo'ronida
achievement.159.description: Oyoq barmoqlari orasiga qum tushgan issiq cho‘l quyoshi ostida o‘zingizni uydagidek his qilasiz va sizning sevimli sayohat vositangiz – uchar gilam. Bundan tashqari, siz boshni izolyatsiya qilish raqs harakatini qilishingiz mumkin.
achievement.159.name: Ming bir
achievement.16.description: Siz plyajda “Shrewni qo‘llab-quvvatlash” filmini qaytadan namoyish qildingiz va injiq qizlarni yaxshi boshqarishingiz mumkinligini isbotladingiz. Baliq dumi bilan yoki bo'lmasdan.
achievement.16.name: Plyaj Tamer
achievement.160.description: Ochiq dengizlarda, o'ljalar va qizlar bilan jang qilib, janob bo'ling! Siz hech kimga yoki portlashi mumkin bo'lgan monarxiyaga javob bermang va sizning hayotingiz nilufar jigaridan emas. Ha, do'stim!
achievement.160.name: [EN] Swashbuckler
achievement.161.description: Olovni chayqash va o'rmonda baraban chalish uchun olov atrofida raqsga tushish sizga yoqadigan narsaga o'xshaydi. Bundan tashqari, dreadlocks - sochlaringizni kiyishning qulay usuli - tarash shart emas!
achievement.161.name: Shamanning yo'li
achievement.162.description: Siz "Qanday qilib eng zo'r hayvonni jahannam tubidan chaqirish mumkin, I jild" nomli asar muallifi bo'lishingiz mumkin. Yoki, agar sizning fikringiz va qalbingiz toza bo'lsa, siz boshqalarga yordam berish uchun mavjudotlarni chaqirasiz. Yoki quchoqlashi uchun kichkina mushuk bo'lishi mumkin.
achievement.162.name: Ritualist
achievement.163.description: Jang qizg'inda o'z ranglaringizni ko'rsatishdan qo'rqmaysiz. Dushmanlar sizning halokatli nayzalaringiz va o'tib bo'lmaydigan zirhlaringizdan qo'rqishadi. Siz g'alaba qozongan urushlar ro'yxati juda ta'sirli. Salom va o'ldir!
achievement.163.name: Urush ustasi
achievement.164.description: Jasorat zaiflar uchundir - jangda qanday g'alaba qozonishingizning ahamiyati yo'q, agar siz g'alaba qozonsangiz. Qalin zirh sizning harakatlaringizga xalaqit beradi, shuning uchun siz uni engil tutasiz va noqulay qobiqda yashirinish o'rniga tezlik va mahoratga tayanasiz.
achievement.164.name: [EN] Wild Warrior
achievement.165.description: Siz sayohat va jang qilish uchun boylik yoki maxsus jihozlarga muhtoj bo'lmagan kamtarin jangchisiz. Siz Zaoning shimoliy erlarida o'zingizni uydagidek his qilasiz va uning korruptsiyasiga qarshi kurashda o'z hissangizni qo'shgansiz.
achievement.165.name: [EN] Peazzekeeper
achievement.166.description: Yalahar uchun qilgan ishlaringiz odatda chuqur tushuncha va o'ylangan harakatlar bilan ajralib turadi. Siz tufayli Yalahar tinch va baxtli odamlar bilan yashash imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishi mumkin.
achievement.166.name: Hikmat Yalahari
achievement.167.description: Siz Yalaharni shafqatsiz kuch bilan himoya qilasiz va agar kerak bo'lsa, uni shonli jangga olib borishga tayyorsiz. Sizga rahmat, Yalahar har qanday dushmanga qarshi tura oladigan darajada qudratli bo'ladi.
achievement.167.name: Qudrat Yalahari
achievement.168.description: Kerakli vaqtda to'g'ri tort bilan hayot juda oson bo'lishi mumkin - va siz turli xil pishiriqlarni pishirishni o'zlashtirdingiz, shuning uchun hayot sizga tashlashga qaror qilgan deyarli hamma narsaga tayyor bo'lishingiz kerak.
achievement.168.name: Kek bo'lagi
achievement.169.description: Eksperimental sehr va afsunni rivojlantirish sohasidagi kashshof kashfiyotlaringiz va muvaffaqiyatli tadqiqotlaringiz tufayli siz Edrondagi Sehrli akademiyaning birinchi darajali bitiruvchisi hisoblanasiz. Hech qachon Armageddon afsunini o'rgatishni o'ylab ko'rganmisiz?
achievement.169.name: Alumni
achievement.17.description: Agar biror narsa qilsangiz, uni to'g'ri qilasiz. Sizning fikringiz bor va siz uni qo'llab-quvvatlaysiz - va hech kim sizni boshqa yo'l bilan ishontira olmaydi. Bir tomondan, siz shafqatsiz va urushga yo'naltirilgan tomondasiz, lekin bu yomon emas, shunday emasmi?
achievement.17.name: Azerusning izdoshi
achievement.170.description: Siz sehrning qorong'u usullarini yaxshi bilasiz va odatda sham va bosh suyagi ichida o'tirib, so'zlab bo'lmaydigan so'zlarni g'o'ldiradi. Narsalarni juda uzoqqa olib bormang, aks holda jinlar sizni tutishi mumkin.
achievement.170.name: Warlock
achievement.171.description: Haqiqatan ham, sizda quyonlar uchun yumshoq joy bor. Balki bugun qutqargan quyonlaringiz ertaga sizni qutqaradigan quyonlardir. Haqiqatan ham och qolganingizda.
achievement.171.name: Bunny sirg'alib ketdi
achievement.172.description: Haqiqiy olimlar o'zlarining jihozlarini bilishadi. Yangi ixtirolarni sinovdan o'tkazish har bir mehnatkash tadqiqotchi uchun muhim kundalik ishdir. Siz hech qanday qo'rquvni ko'rsatmadingiz va Spektulus va Sinclairdan barcha yangi jihozlarni aylanib chiqish uchun oldingiz.
achievement.172.name: Gvineya cho'chqasi
achievement.173.description: Siz o'rmonga borib, Rottin Vud va turmush qurgan erkaklar bilan uchrashdingiz va lagerida ularga yordam berdingiz. Oh, va bu savdogarlar haqida tashvishlanmang. Ular o'zlarida mavjud bo'lgan va hozirda yo'qolgan g'alati katta miqdordagi oltin haqida gapirishga jur'at eta olmaydilar.
achievement.173.name: Quvnoq sarguzashtlar
achievement.174.description: Siz ularning sinovidan o‘tdingiz va “Spirithunters”ga uskunalarni sinovdan o‘tkazishda, g‘ayritabiiy va arvohlarni o‘rganishda yordam berdingiz – ular sizni chaqirishadi.
achievement.174.name: Hech qanday arvohdan qo'rqmang!
achievement.175.description: Zaodagi Chartan uchun sinab ko'rgan deyarli barcha o'simliklarni yeb bo'lmaydi - siz ularning barchasini tatib ko'rdingiz, lekin siz hali ham turibsiz! Haqiqatan ham hozir toza havo olishingiz kerak.
achievement.175.name: [EN] Extreme Degustation
achievement.176.description: Siz tort oroliga jasorat bilan qadam qo'ydingiz. Butun dunyoda bo'lish uchun bundan go'zal, mazali joy bormi?
achievement.176.name: Kek zabt etuvchi
achievement.177.description: Siz jin chaqaloqning ko'nglini ko'tarib, onasiga qaytarib berdingiz. Barmoqlaringizni tez sanab o'tishni hech qanday zarar ko'rmaganligingizni aniqlaydi.
achievement.177.name: Chaqaloq enagasi
achievement.178.description: Siz bir guruh jin go‘daklarning ko‘nglini ko‘tarib, onasiga qaytardingiz. Kuyish izlarini bezovta qilma, oqargan sochlarning tarangligini bezovta qilma, baqirib uyg'ongan tunlarni bezovta qilma. Bunga arziydi ... ehtimol ... qandaydir tarzda.
achievement.178.name: Do'zaxdan enaga
achievement.179.description: Siz sharpa kapitan bilan tub dengizlarni suzib yurgansiz. Xavf-xatarlarga qaramay, siz va sizning ekipaj a'zolaringiz qiyinchilikka dosh berdingiz.
achievement.179.name: Arvoh dengizchi
achievement.18.description: Siz tinchlikparvarsiz va kichik odamlar nima deyishini tinglang. Siz qaror qildingiz va kimga va qanday sabablarga ko'ra yordam berishni bildingiz - va buni izchil bajarasiz. Sizning urushingiz qurol bilan emas, balki aql bilan olib boriladi.
achievement.18.name: Palimutning izdoshi
achievement.180.description: Siz Arvoh kapitan bilan bir necha bor dengizlarni suzib o'tgansiz. Golning xavf-xatarlari sizga tanish bo'lib qoldi va tajribasiz sayohatchilar maslahat uchun sizga murojaat qilishadi.
achievement.180.name: Spektral sayohatchi
achievement.181.description: O'lim yoki arvohlardan qo'rqmasdan, siz sharpa kapitan bilan bir necha bor sayohat qilgansiz va dunyoning tajribali sayohatchisisiz. O'liklar va tiriklar sizning mehnatlaringiz haqida minnatdorchilik bilan pichirlashadi.
achievement.181.name: [EN] Nether Pirate
achievement.182.description: Siz chuqur dengizning ustasisiz va arvoh kapitan bilan shunchalik ko'p sayohat qildingizki, siz uning kemasini va chuqur dengizning xavf-xatarlarini bilasiz. Siz o'lim oldida kulasiz va keyingi hayotda o'zingiz arvoh qaroqchi sifatida qaytishingiz mumkin!
achievement.182.name: O'lim balosi
achievement.183.description: Siz jodugarlarning olovini yoqishga yordam berdingiz. Barmoqlaringizni kuzatib turing, havo issiq!
achievement.183.name: Olovli chiroq
achievement.184.description: Siz jodugarlarning himoya pivosini yaratish uchun ingredientlarni qurbon qildingiz.
achievement.184.name: Jodugarlar Lil yordamchisi
achievement.185.description: Siz jodugarlarning himoya pivosini yaratish uchun juda ko'p ingredientlarni qurbon qildingiz va qo'rqinchli vahimachilarni qaytarish harakatlarida muhim rol o'ynadingiz. Kamchilik shundaki, hatto ahmoqlar ham sizga e'tibor berishlari mumkin ...
achievement.185.name: [EN] Banebringers' Bane
achievement.186.description: Jodugarlarning olovini yondirib qo'yish uchun siz o'tinning ko'p qismini jonlantirdingiz. Ba'zilar sizning olovga bo'lgan qiziqishingizni ... bezovta qilishi mumkin.
achievement.186.name: Fire Devil
achievement.187.description: Sevgi ... olov! Shunday ... porloq! Kerak ... buuuurrrn!
achievement.187.name: Pyromaniac
achievement.188.description: Bekorchilarga qarshi kurashda qilgan sa'y-harakatlaringiz e'tibordan chetda qolmadi. Siz jodugarlar orasida afsonasiz va sizning ismingiz hayrat va hayrat bilan pichirlangan.
achievement.188.name: Faxriy jodugar
achievement.189.description: Oh, minishning quvonchi! Sizda birinchi o'zingizning tog'ingiz bor. Qulaylik bilan sizga otxona ham kerak emas, lekin uni xohlagan vaqtda chaqirishingiz mumkin.
achievement.189.name: Tabiiy tug'ilgan kovboy
achievement.19.description: Sizga taklif qilingan ov sinovi uchun har qanday imkoniyatdan sakrab chiqasiz va bu vazifalarni o'lik aniqlik bilan bajarasiz. Siz chin yurakdan ovchisiz va Paw & Fur jamiyatining qimmatli a'zosisiz.
achievement.19.name: Elita Hunter
achievement.190.description: Toshlar sizni doimo o'ziga jalb qilgan. Shunday qilib, ulardan birining ichida haqiqatan ham qimmatbaho narsani topish imkoniyati mavjud. Statistik ma'lumotlarga ko'ra, siz hozirgacha bir nechta yaxshi xazinani kashf qilishingiz kerak edi. Ammo yana, ko'pchilik statistik ma'lumotlar Ona baxtsizliklari tomonidan bekor qilinadi.
achievement.190.name: [EN] Petrologist
achievement.191.description: Siz qadimgilarning yashirin kuchlarini kashf qildingiz - bundan buyon ular sizga sarguzashtlaringizda yordam beradi.
achievement.191.name: Yashirin kuchlar
achievement.192.description: Siz, albatta, mebel va bezak buyumlaringizning eng yaxshisini qanday chiqarishni bilasiz. Chiroyli.
achievement.192.name: Menga Fancy yoqadi
achievement.193.description: Siz har doim obsidian pichog'ingizni o'zingiz bilan olib yurasiz va uni ishlatishdan tortinmaysiz. Siz son-sanoqsiz kichik va kattaroq jonzotlarning terisini tozaladingiz va ha: ular odatda ichki jihatdan go'zalroq bo'lmaydi. Bu ko'proq qon va qon va boshqalar ...
achievement.193.name: Teri chuqurligi
achievement.194.description: Vampirlar va jinlarni staking deyarli sizning kasbingizga aylandi. Siz hatto eng kichik miqdordagi yomon chang zarralarini to'plashingizga ishonch hosil qilasiz. Silikozdan ehtiyot bo'ling.
achievement.194.name: Kuldan changga
achievement.196.description: Xavotir olmang, uni sizdan hech kim tortib ololmaydi. Balki.
achievement.196.name: Xavfsiz saqlangan
achievement.197.description: Xudoga qasamki! U nima edi; Nima bo'lgandi?
achievement.197.name: Ichkarida nimadir bor
achievement.198.description: awww. Sizning kichkina oltin baliq do'stingiz - u yoqimli, u porloq va agar siz uni ovqatlantirishni unutsangiz, u shikoyat qila olmaydi. U, albatta, kuningizni yoritadi!
achievement.198.name: Jim uy hayvonlari
achievement.199.description: Sakrash, qorda sakrash - bu eng qiziqarli yo'l! Shoshqaloqlik bilan oyoq izlarini qo'yish - qanchalik shoshsangiz qiziqroq bo'ladi! Kun bo'yi muzlarni yalash - Qish, hech qachon ketmang!
achievement.199.name: Qor quyon
achievement.2.description: Lalalala... endi Ozodlik ko‘rfazida aytiladigan kult madhiyasini yoddan bilasiz. Asosan ikkita nota va takrorlanuvchi so'zlardan iborat ekanligini hisobga olsak, unchalik qiyin emas.
achievement.2.name: Xorist
achievement.20.description: Siz ov vazifalari bilan tanishsiz va allaqachon bir nechtasini bajargansiz. Oldinda Paw & Fur jamiyati uchun ovchi sifatida yorqin martaba kutmoqda!
achievement.20.name: Huntsman
achievement.200.description: Yomon la'natlar, yovuz sehr - siz boshqalarni shubhali vositalar bilan jazolashdan qochmaysiz. Kimdir sizga g'alati qaradi - endi o'sha igna yana qayerda?
achievement.200.name: Qorong'u vudu ruhoniysi
achievement.201.description: Uy - bu sizning sevimli ov joyingiz va siz ba'zi joylarni boshqalardan ko'ra qadrliroq tutsangiz ham, siz hech qachon bir shaharda uzoq vaqt qolish uchun etarlicha bog'lanib qolmaysiz. Barcha narsalarni yig'ing - yana harakat qilish vaqti keldi.
achievement.201.name: Ko'chmanchi ruh
achievement.202.description: Siz Jekga sizni tushuntirib, haqiqatni aytdingiz va Spectulus uni butunlay boshqa odam ekanligiga ishontirishga urinib, xato qildi.
achievement.202.name: Haqiqatni aytish
achievement.203.description: Siz Jekga Spektulus bilan uni butunlay boshqa odam ekanligiga ishontirishga urinib, qilgan xatoingiz haqida haqiqatni aytmadingiz. U hayotining oxirigacha shubha bilan yashaydi.
achievement.203.name: Siz Jekni tanimaysiz
achievement.204.description: Birlashgan Sehrli Winterberry Jamiyati shu bilan Yillik Kuz Vintageida fidokorona fidoyilik va g'ayrioddiy sa'y-harakatlarni sharaflaydi.
achievement.204.name: [EN] Berry Picker
achievement.205.description: Siz va sizning do'stlaringiz uchta sehrgarga sodiqligingizni uch marta ko'rsatdingiz - aminmanki, ulardan kamida bittasi siz bilan abadiy minnatdor va juda faxrlanadi.
achievement.205.name: Haqiqiy ranglar
achievement.206.description: Siz barcha mumkin bo'lgan shakllarda Kuriks chaqiruvini o'zlashtirgansiz.
achievement.206.name: [EN] Master Shapeshifter
achievement.207.description: Kichkina do'stona yordamchingizning yordami bilan siz 500 dan ortiq shilimshiq bo'laklarni yutib oldingiz. Yaxshi, Slimer.
achievement.207.name: Yupqaroq
achievement.208.description: Siz g'azablangan sehrgarni Zao janubidagi minorasida o'ldirdingiz. Yana. Lekin bu faqat qaytib keladi. O'lchovli portal yana bir bor qulab tushdi va bilasizki, u oxir-oqibat qaytib keladi, lekin ey - g'azablangan sehrgar, buni so'rashga o'xshaydi ...
achievement.208.name: Mageslayer
achievement.209.description: Siz ellikta kam uchraydigan yaltiroq suzuvchilarni tutdingiz. O‘sha jasadlarni ko‘lga tashlash orqali qutulish haqiqatan ham bunga arziydi, shunday emasmi? Kutib turing, hozir suvda biror narsa qimirlamadimi...?
achievement.209.name: [EN] Biodegradable
achievement.21.description: Siz uchun o'pish oddiy lablarga teginishdan ko'ra ko'proq narsadir. Siz qizlarni ham, o'liklarni ham tengsiz mehr bilan o'pasiz va banshi malikasining o'pishi orqali o'lim va qayta tug'ilishga duch kelasiz. Siz bilan shunday samimiy daqiqalarni baham ko'rganlar baxtlidir!
achievement.21.name: Ehtirosli Kisser
achievement.210.description: Siz buni ko'rib chiqmadingiz - hech bo'lmaganda juda uzoq vaqt emas ... lekin Groam. Va siz uni tinchlantirdingiz. Faqat do'sti Dronkga aytmang.
achievement.210.name: Chuqurning ko'zi
achievement.211.description: Sizning qo'lingizdan chuqurlikdagi ko'plab mavjudotlar o'z jonlarini yo'qotdi. Uch yuz kishi abadiyat qa'riga kirdi. Ehtimol, siz chuqur ko'zlarning qasosidan qo'rqishingiz kerak.
achievement.211.name: Chuqurlik bosqinchisi
achievement.212.description: Siz 500 ta tikanli olovni o'chirdingiz! Yong'in qo'zg'atuvchilari Shadowthornni egallab olishganda siz u erda bo'lgansiz. Siz kunni va sizni o'ldirishga harakat qiladigan ba'zi elflarning uyini saqlab qoldingiz. Hammasi avvalgidek tiklanganini ko'rish yoqimli emasmi..?
achievement.212.name: [EN] Firefighter
achievement.213.description: Siz to'rt yuzdan ortiq oq kiyikni o'ldirishga muvaffaq bo'ldingiz - siz ularning tez orada yo'q bo'lib ketgan deb hisoblanishining asosiy sabablaridan biri bo'lganga o'xshaysiz!
achievement.213.name: Deer Hunt
achievement.214.description: Sen endi Asroqning shoh bosh shaydosisan, shahzoda qotil.
achievement.214.name: [EN] Askarak Nemesis
achievement.215.description: Siz endi Shaburakning xalq dushmanisiz, shahzoda qotil.
achievement.215.name: [EN] Shaburak Nemesis
achievement.216.description: Siz Horestis kosasini ellik marta sindirdingiz. Yoki siz qo'rquvni bilmaysiz yoki shunchaki unga e'tibor bermaysiz. Qanday bo'lmasin, siz haqiqatan ham "qo'rqmassiz".
achievement.216.name: Qo'rqmas
achievement.217.description: Kimdir shifokorni chaqirdimi? Qiyin paytlarda Venore kambag'allar uyidagi Ottokarga 100 dona dori-darmon qopini yetkazib berdingiz, yaxshi!
achievement.217.name: Doktor! Doktor!
achievement.218.description: Siz Venorening jabrlangan fuqarolariga qiyin paytlarda katta yordam berdingiz. Qanday bo'lmasin, siz hali ham isitma qurbonlari bilan yaqinroq bo'lasiz. Kiyiming seni ulardan biriga, son-sanoqsiz musibatlarga duchor bo'lgan bechora qalblardan biri qiladi.
achievement.218.name: Gaga doktori
achievement.219.description: Siz aqldan ozgan sehrgarni mag'lub etdingiz, g'azablangan sehrgarni bo'ysundingiz - hech qanday sehrgar o'z-o'zini fosh etuvchi sizning yo'lingizda turolmaydi. Shunga qaramay, siz o'zingiz sehrli tadqiqotlar bilan shug'ullanasiz. Aynan shu mato sehrli san'atning shaxsiy roziligini aks ettiradi.
achievement.219.name: Mistik mato sehri
achievement.22.description: Siz o'zingizni "oila" ning munosib a'zosi sifatida isbotladingiz va Venoreya savdogarlari va ularning maqsadlarini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun "amaki" uchun ko'plab josuslik missiyalarini muvaffaqiyatli bajardingiz.
achievement.22.name: Eng yaxshi AVIN agenti
achievement.221.description: Siz Bloodwebning sakkizta muzlatilgan oyog'ining har birini sindirdingiz. Ular aytganidek: oyog'ini sindirish, keyin yana bir oz.
achievement.221.name: Araxnoise
achievement.222.description: Siz Deathbine uyining botqoqli qa'riga tushdingiz va uni tezda bajardingiz.
achievement.222.name: Ildizsiz xulq-atvor
achievement.223.description: Siz mutatsiyaga uchragan kalamushlarning eng jirkanch va tajovuzkori Esmeraldani o'ldirdingiz. Bu jarayonda barmog'ingizni deyarli yo'qotganingizni hech kim bilmaydi.
achievement.223.name: [EN] Twisted Mutation
achievement.224.description: Etershrekning iztirobli faryodi u havoga eriganidan keyin ham bir necha soat davomida qulog'ingizda jaranglab turdi. U, ehtimol, boshqa mavjudlik tekisligiga ko'chib o'tdi ... bir muddat.
achievement.224.name: Chiroyli Agoniya
achievement.225.description: Bugun kuchli olov yondi. Hayot va o'limning abadiy tsiklida qayta tug'ilishini kutish navbati Flamebornga keldi.
achievement.225.name: Kuygan olovlar
achievement.226.description: Siz qadimiy qoraqo'tir Fleshcrawlerni parchalab tashladingiz va uning teri ostiga tushmasligiga ishonch hosil qildingiz.
achievement.226.name: Emaklab yuruvchi o'lim
achievement.227.description: Siz Gorgoning tirik jingalaklari bilan tugun qildingiz va uning bosh terisini oldingiz. Siz uning son-sanoqsiz toshbo'ron qurbonlarini qutqara olmadingiz, lekin hech bo'lmaganda siz bunday bo'lmadingiz.
achievement.227.name: Ilonning kelini
achievement.228.description: Siz yaxshi yashiringan o'rgimchak malikasini topdingiz va uni ovqat paytida qo'lga oldingiz.
achievement.228.name: Boshqa yashirish yo'q
achievement.229.description: Ko'rinib turibdiki, yer osti dunyosining darvozalari bir muddat himoyasiz qolishi kerak. Kerberos, qudratli do'zax iti boshini yo'qotdi. Ularning uchtasi.
achievement.229.name: Jahannam eshiklari
achievement.23.description: Qizning kuchi! Siz ayolmisiz yoki yo'qmi, siz mutlaqo sodiqligingizni va Karlin qizlar brigadasi uchun hayotingizni xavf ostiga qo'yishga tayyor ekanligingizni isbotladingiz.
achievement.23.name: Eng yaxshi CGB agenti
achievement.230.description: Bahaybat dengiz iloni Leviafanning qotili sifatida uning suv osti shohligi endi sizning hukmronligingiz ostida.
achievement.230.name: Cho'kilgan dengiz xudosi
achievement.231.description: Ribstrid endi qadam tashlamayapti. Uning bir nechta qovurg'alari bor edi.
achievement.231.name: Kechki ovqat uchun spareribs
achievement.232.description: Siz Shardxed bilan deyarli do'stlashdingiz... o'limidan oldin. Kambag'al yigit faqat o'zining sovuq munosabati bilan zo'ravonlikni o'ziga tortadi.
achievement.232.name: Muzni sindirish
achievement.233.description: Toshqo‘rg‘onning boshi u sizga tashlagan toshlardan ancha yumshoqroq edi.
achievement.233.name: Shunchaki meni sindirib tashladi!
achievement.234.description: Siz Oltingugurt Skattlerning gaz bulutlarini o'chirdingiz va uning g'oridagi havoni biroz yaxshiladingiz ... hech bo'lmaganda bir muddat.
achievement.234.name: Nimadir hidlaydi
achievement.235.description: Siz katta mamont Bloodtuskni o'z tishlari bilan mixlab qo'ydingiz.
achievement.235.name: Go'shtli shish
achievement.236.description: Ko'pchilik endi yo'q, lekin yana qanchasi bor? Hech qachon bilish mumkin emas.
achievement.236.name: Bir kam
achievement.237.description: Siz Noxious Spawn va uning serpantin yuragi ustidan g'alaba qozondingiz.
achievement.237.name: Hirsting qulashi
achievement.238.description: Keksa beva ayol sizning eng yuqori ov mahoratingizga o'lja bo'ldi.
achievement.238.name: Uning zahariga bo'g'ilish
achievement.239.description: Siz o'rmon polini Snapperning qip-qizil qoni bilan bulg'andingiz.
achievement.239.name: Qon-qizil Snapper
achievement.24.description: Fitna va ochiq sirlar sizning kundalik noningizdir. Dushmanlar bilan to'qnash kelish va josuslik missiyalarini bajarishda jasoratingiz orqali Tailand tojiga sodiqligingizni ko'rsatdingiz. Siz TBIning ajoyib dala agentisiz.
achievement.24.name: Eng yaxshi TBI agenti
achievement.240.description: Siz bugun juda ko'p chodirlarni kesib tashladingiz. Tul o'zi tegishli joyga qaytarildi.
achievement.240.name: Abyssga qaytish
achievement.241.description: Paw va Fur jamiyati sizni o'ldirish uchun yuborgan ko'plab kuchli boshliqlarga duch keldingiz va ularni mag'lub qildingiz. Hammasi o'zingdan. Qanday ov!
achievement.241.name: Juda ko'p mo'ynali kiyimlarni qo'lga kiritdi
achievement.242.description: Siz bank o‘g‘risini to‘xtatib, to‘la tillani qaytarib berdingiz. Atrofingizda siz kabi qonuniy tibiyaliklar borligini bilish yaxshi.
achievement.242.name: Halol topuvchi
achievement.243.description: Agar siz bo'lmaganingizda, Tibiadagi bir nechta banklar hozirgacha bankrot bo'lgan bo'lardi. Bank qaroqchilarini ta'qib qilishda davom eting va hech kim Tibian iqtisodiyoti haqida qayg'urmasligi kerak!
achievement.243.name: Oltin ovchi
achievement.244.description: Siz hamma joyda yugurib yurgan ulkan oyoq izlari va dahshatli fillarning izini topdingiz. Nahotki, sirli maymun xudo o'rmonda sayr qilib yurgandir?
achievement.244.name: Maymun Xudoning izi
achievement.245.description: Bu ulkan o'rgimchak EMAS edi. Bu yerda qandaydir jodugarlik bor.
achievement.245.name: Kimdir zerikdi
achievement.246.description: Siz sir saqlay olmaysiz, shunday emasmi? Yana siz qonuniy fuqaro sifatida Karlin qirolichasi oldidagi burchingizni bajaryapsiz. Bu yaxshi narsa, shunday emasmi...?
achievement.246.name: Hushtakchi
achievement.247.description: Wyda haqiqatan ham zerikkanga o'xshaydi. Bundan tashqari, siz unga sarguzashtlar olib kelgan barcha qonli o'tlarga muhtoj emasligini bildingiz. Shunday bo'lsa-da, u sizdan birini olish uchun etarlicha yaxshi edi va evaziga sizga juda yaxshi narsa berdi.
achievement.247.name: Yirtilgan xazinalar
achievement.248.description: Siz Kingsday bayramlariga qo'shildingiz va qirol Tibianusga hurmat ko'rsatdingiz. Endi bayramga boring!
achievement.248.name: Sodiq mavzu
achievement.249.description: Siz, odatda, suv ham olib yurmaydigan joyda baliq ovlashga muvaffaq bo'ldingiz. Hamma narsa o'zgarishi mumkin, ehtimol ...
achievement.249.name: Cho'l baliqchisi
achievement.25.description: Ayg'oqchi jihozlaringizni to'plang va maxfiy agentlik xizmatidagi xavfli missiyalarga tayyorlaning. Siz buni xohlayotganingizni ko'rsatdingiz - lekin buni qila olasizmi? Vaqt ko'rsatadi.
achievement.25.name: Maxfiy agent
achievement.251.description: Noodlesga uyga yo'l ko'rsatdingiz. U yana bo'shashguncha bu vaqt qancha vaqt oladi? O'sha it allaqachon taxt xonasida zerikib qolgan bo'lsa kerak.
achievement.251.name: It boquvchisi
achievement.252.description: Siz Svargrondning erishi guvohi bo'ldingiz va g'alati muzli o'simliklardan noyob urug'larni yig'ib oldingiz. Ular biror narsa uchun yaxshi bo'lishi kerak.
achievement.252.name: Muz yig'uvchi
achievement.253.description: Siz juda aqlli mutafakkirsiz va abadiy gullar yaratishga muvaffaq bo'ldingiz. Ular yashil bosh barmog'i bilan muborak bo'lmagan yoki shunchaki unutuvchan odamlar orasida katta hitga aylanishi mumkin.
achievement.253.name: [EN] Preservationist
achievement.254.description: Siz uchta ko'chmanchi lagerni topdingiz va ularning zaxiralarini o'g'irladingiz. Xo'sh, ehtimol siz ulardan yaxshiroq foydalanishingiz mumkin.
achievement.254.name: Ko'krak qaroqchisi
achievement.255.description: Siz suv bosgan tekisliklarda yashirin zindonni topdingiz va uning bir necha aholisini o'ldirdingiz. Va endi sizning oyoqlaringiz nam.
achievement.255.name: Drenajdan pastga
achievement.256.description: Siz Hellgorge otilishidan omon qoldingiz va olov va lavadan o'tish yo'lini topdingiz. Siz hatto yo'lda bir nechta olov tug'ilganlarni o'ldirishga muvaffaq bo'ldingiz.
achievement.256.name: Yerdan olov
achievement.257.description: Sizning harakatlaringiz farq qila boshlaydi. Siz uyaning antennalarini tez-tez ko'r qilib qo'ygansiz, bu sizni bezovta qiladi.
achievement.257.name: Kichik bezovtalik
achievement.258.description: Uyaga qarshi urushda uni ko'r qilish uchun qilgan harakatlaringiz o'z samarasini bera boshlaydi. Sizning harakatlaringiz uyani jiddiy ravishda ko'r qildi va mavjudlik xavfli narsa yuz berayotganidan xabardor bo'lib qolganga o'xshaydi.
achievement.258.name: Dazzler
achievement.259.description: Quirefangda nima bo'layotganidan bexabar bo'lish uchun siz ko'p vaqt va kuch sarfladingiz. Uya sizning harakatlaringizdan qo'rqishni o'rgandi. U, albatta, sizni bor kuchi bilan ezib tashlagan bo'lardi ... agar u sizni topsa!
achievement.259.name: [EN] Hive Blinder
achievement.26.description: Siz intiluvchan mago-mexaniksiz. Ilm-fan va sehr sizning ko'z o'ngingizda yaxshi ishlaydi - va siz Telasda ishlayotganingizda son-sanoqsiz noto'g'ri ayblovlarni topshirgan bo'lsangiz ham, hozir o'z golemingizni yaratish uchun etarli bilimga ega bo'lishingiz mumkin.
achievement.26.name: Gears ichida Golem
achievement.260.description: Siz uyaning oshqozon tizimiga tez-tez borishga o'rganib qolgansiz. Sizning harakatlaringiz uyada birinchi ovqat hazm qilish muammolarini keltirib chiqardi.
achievement.260.name: Hickup
achievement.261.description: Hech qachon charchamasdan, siz qudratli uyaning ichki organlariga hujum qilasiz. Sizning uyaning ovqat hazm qilish tizimiga hujumlaringiz ba'zi muammolarni keltirib chiqara boshlaydi.
achievement.261.name: Oshqozon yonishi
achievement.262.description: Siz uyaning hazm bo'lishini jiddiy ravishda buzdingiz. Uya, albatta, shifokorga murojaat qilishi kerak. Ko'rinib turibdiki, siz yuta oladigan darajada ko'proq ekanligingizni isbotladingiz.
achievement.262.name: Oshqozon yarasi
achievement.263.description: Uya bilan kuchli va asosiy kurashish kerak, uning askarlariga to'sqinlik qilish faqat birinchi qadamdir. Siz uning jangchilarini yoyish uchun uyaning teshiklarini astoydil to'xtatdingiz.
achievement.263.name: Ekuvchi
achievement.264.description: Siz dushman kuchlarining ta'minotini yo'q qilishda tobora ko'proq tajribaga ega bo'lasiz. Sizning harakatlaringiz uyaga jiddiy teri muammolarini keltirib chiqardi.
achievement.264.name: Pimple
achievement.265.description: Urushda eng yaxshi qo'shin bilan ta'minlanganlar g'alaba qozonadi. Sizning harakatlaringiz tufayli uyaning qo'shinlari sezilarli zarbaga uchradi. Siz uyani qo'shinlar bilan to'ldirishni doimiy va jiddiy ravishda to'xtatdingiz.
achievement.265.name: Suppressor
achievement.266.description: Uyadagi mavjudotlarni o'ldirish va keyingi topshiriqlar uchun qurol olish orqali siz juda samarali urush usulini boshladingiz. Siz urushni to'ldirish uchun juda ko'p erigan xitin to'pladingiz.
achievement.266.name: Yig'uvchi
achievement.267.description: Ta'minotga bo'lgan ehtiyoj ko'pincha yo'qotish yoki g'alabani hal qiladi. Resurslarni qayta ta'minlash bo'yicha tinimsiz sa'y-harakatlaringiz uyaga qarshi urushni davom ettiradi.
achievement.267.name: Yetkazib beruvchi
achievement.268.description: Siz uyaga qarshi kurashish uchun zarur bo'lgan moddalarni to'plashda malakali va samarali bo'ldingiz. Siz deyarli erigan xitin hidiga o'xshaysiz va uyadan tug'ilganlar, agar ular gapira olsalar, o'z farzandlariga siz haqingizda dahshatli voqealarni aytib berishadi.
achievement.268.name: [EN] Chitin Bane
achievement.269.description: Siz uyaning eng yaxshisini mag'lub etishingiz mumkinligini isbotladingiz. Siz uyani himoya qilishda birinchi istiqbolli buzilishlarni keltirib chiqardingiz
achievement.269.name: Qo'riqchi qotil
achievement.27.description: Siz ko'p marta aytgan she'rlar, she'rlar, qo'shiqlar va qofiyalar. Siz sirli eshikdan o'tdingiz, qadimiy ilmlarning raconteori. Siz hatto elflarni ham hayratda qoldirgansiz, shuning uchun siz haqiqatan ham barakali ekansiz.
achievement.27.name: Shoir mukofoti laureati
achievement.270.description: Uyaning eng kuchli jangchilari o'nlab odamlar tomonidan o'ldirilgan. Sizning harakatlaringiz tufayli uya endi xavfsiz emas.
achievement.270.name: [EN] Hive Infiltrator
achievement.271.description: Samarali va halokatli, siz uyaning elita kuchlariga qarshi kurashda katta tajribaga ega bo'ldingiz. Deyarli yolg'iz, siz uyaning eng yaxshilarini o'ldirdingiz va ertakni aytib berish uchun yashadingiz.
achievement.271.name: [EN] Exterminator
achievement.272.description: Uyaning eng chuqur tuzilmalarida ham siz kuchli dushmanga zarba bera boshladingiz. Sizning harakatlaringiz, ehtimol, uyaga bosh og'rig'ini keltirdi.
achievement.272.name: Bosh og'rig'i
achievement.273.description: Siz keltirgan halokat butun uyada seziladi. Sizning qadamingizdan keyin sodir bo'lgan tartibsizlik uyaning ongida jiddiy chalkashliklarni keltirib chiqardi.
achievement.273.name: Chalkashlik
achievement.274.description: Siz uyaning muhim nerv markazlarining katta qismini vayron qildingiz va uyaning ongini katta vayron qildingiz. Ehtimol, siz uyaga dahshatli dahshatli tushlarni keltirib chiqarasiz.
achievement.274.name: Manik
achievement.276.name: Navigatsiya xatosi
achievement.277.description: Siz sharq sayyohi Yosirni topdingiz va u bilan savdo qila oldingiz - hatto tilini tushunmasangiz ham.
achievement.277.name: Si, Ariki!
achievement.278.description: Siz uch yuzdan ortiq Deepling gvardiyasining hayotini tugatdingiz. Siz Deeplingsning qo'riqchisi emassiz, shunday emasmi?
achievement.278.name: [EN] Guardian Downfall
achievement.279.description: Siz uch yuzdan ortiq Deepling Spellsingerni yo'q qilib, qora chuqurlikda urush qo'shiqlarini o'chirdingiz.
achievement.279.name: O'lim qo'shig'i
achievement.28.description: Sizga berilgan har qanday musiqa asbobini boshqarishingiz mumkin va u bilan yoqimli ovoz chiqarishga muvaffaq bo'lasiz. Siz ko'pchilik tavernalarda xush kelibsiz mehmon va tomoshabinsiz.
achievement.28.name: Minstrel
achievement.280.description: Kamida uch yuzta chuqur jangchini yo'q qilish orqali siz chuqurliklarning to'plangan qo'shinlariga katta zarba berdingiz.
achievement.280.name: Chuqurlik aholisi
achievement.281.description: Siz birinchi marvaridingizni kesdingiz - va u sizning nomingiz bilan atalgan! Endi bu yaxshi sovg'a bo'ladi! Biroq, bu uni "haqiqiy" dengiz yuragiga aylantirmaydi ...
achievement.281.name: Gem Cutter
achievement.282.description: Siz aynan shu dunyoning qa'rini kezdingiz. Siz Chuqurliklar shohligini zabt etish uchun chuqur dengizning qorasiga kirdingiz. Bu kostyum sizga quyidagi g'alati go'zallikni eslatsin.
achievement.282.name: [EN] Spolium Profundis
achievement.283.description: [EN] Countless fights and never tiring effort in the war against the hive grant you the experience to finish your outfit with the last remaining part. Your chitin outfit is a testament of your skills and dedication for the cause.
achievement.283.name: [EN] Bane of the Hive
achievement.285.description: [EN] Your invaluable experience in fighting the hive allows you to add another piece of armor to your chitin outfit to prove your dedication for the cause.
achievement.285.name: [EN] Hive War Veteran
achievement.286.description: [EN] You have participated that much in the hive war, that you are able to create some makeshift armor from the remains of dead hive born that can be found in the major hive, to show of your skill.
achievement.286.name: [EN] Hive Fighter
achievement.287.description: [EN] You muted the everlasting howling of Hemming.
achievement.287.name: [EN] Howly Silence
achievement.288.description: [EN] No more fear and bad dreams. You stabbed Tormentor to death with its scythe leg.
achievement.288.name: [EN] Dream's Over
achievement.289.description: [EN] You wiped Fazzrah away - zzeemzz like now you're the captain.
achievement.289.name: [EN] Zzztill Zzztanding!
achievement.29.description: Siz Banutani besh qo'lingizdek bilasiz va qutilar va idishlarni yo'q qilishni yaxshi bilasiz. Ulkan oyoq izlarini ko'rish ham sizni noma'lum joylarni o'rganishga xalaqit bermaydi.
achievement.29.name: Maymunlarning do'sti
achievement.290.description: [EN] This time you knocked out the big one.
achievement.290.name: [EN] Stepped on a Big Toe
achievement.291.description: [EN] No joke, you murdered the bat.
achievement.291.name: Kapow!
achievement.292.description: [EN] You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
achievement.292.name: [EN] Enter zze Draken!
achievement.293.description: [EN] Bretzecutioner's body just got slammed away. You are a true king of the ring!
achievement.293.name: [EN] King of the Ring
achievement.294.description: [EN] You overcame the undead Zanakeph and sent him back into the darkness that spawned him.
achievement.294.name: [EN] Back from the Dead
achievement.295.description: [EN] You've faced and defeated each of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
achievement.295.name: [EN] Pwned All Fur
achievement.297.description: [EN] You lend a helping hand in defeating invading Orcs by destroying their warcamp along with their leader. Bibby's personal bloodbath...
achievement.297.name: [EN] Bibby's Bloodbath
achievement.298.description: [EN] You cleansed the land from an eight legged nuisance by defeating Mamma Longlegs three times. She won't be back soon... or will she?
achievement.298.name: Nestling
achievement.299.description: [EN] You did it! You convinced the reclusive gnomes to accept you as one of their Bigfoots. Now you are ready to help them. With big feet big missions seen to come.
achievement.299.name: [EN] Becoming a Bigfoot
achievement.3.name: Sog'uvchi
achievement.30.description: Sizning xaritangiz sizning do'stingiz - har doim orqa cho'ntagingizda va qiziqarli va foydali joylarning son-sanoqsiz belgilari bilan qoplangan. Aytish mumkinki, siz usiz yo'qolib ketishingiz mumkin - lekin baxtga uni sizdan tortib olishning iloji yo'q.
achievement.30.name: Hududiy
achievement.300.description: [EN] You think the gnomes start to like you. A little step for a Bigfoot but a big step for humanity.
achievement.300.name: [EN] Gnome Little Helper
achievement.301.description: [EN] The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your big feet into areas few humans have walked before.
achievement.301.name: [EN] Gnome Friend
achievement.302.description: [EN] You have become a household name in gnomish society! Your name is mentioned by gnomes more than once. Of course usually by gnomish mothers whose children refuse to eat their mushroom soup, but you are certainly making some tremendous progress.
achievement.302.name: Gnomelike
achievement.303.description: [EN] You accomplished what few humans ever will: you truly impressed the gnomes. This might not change their outlook on humanity as a whole, but at least you can bathe in gnomish respect! And don't forget you're now allowed to enter the warzones!
achievement.303.name: [EN] Honorary Gnome
achievement.304.description: [EN] You brought two loving crystals together. Perhaps they might even name one of their children after you. Too bad you forgot to leave your calling card.
achievement.304.name: [EN] Crystals in Love
achievement.305.description: [EN] Ring-a-ding! You have visited the golem workshop and lent a hand in repairing them. To know those golems are safe is worth all the bruises, isn't it?
achievement.305.name: [EN] Substitute Tinker
achievement.306.description: [EN] After hunting for the correct mushrooms and their spores you're starting to feel like a mushroom yourself. A few times more and you might start thinking like a mushroom, who knows?
achievement.306.name: [EN] Spore Hunter
achievement.307.description: [EN] Burnt fingers and itching lungs are a small price for bringing those gnomes some lousy stone and getting almost killed! Your mother warned you to better become a farmer.
achievement.307.name: [EN] Grinding Again
achievement.308.description: [EN] Seen it all. Done it all. Your unstoppable force swept through the dungeons and you vanquished their masters. Not to forget the precious loot you took! Now stop reading this and continue hunting! Time is money after all!
achievement.308.name: [EN] Dungeon Cleaner
achievement.309.description: [EN] So you repaired the light of some crystals for those gnomes. What's next? Sitting a week in a mushroom bed as a temporary mushroom?
achievement.309.name: [EN] Crystal Keeper
achievement.31.description: Siz Marid uchun qimmatli ittifoqchi ekanligingizni isbotladingiz va Gabel hohlagan vaqtda Xorun va Nah'Bob bilan savdo qilishingizni mamnuniyat bilan qabul qildi. Jinlar urushi hali ham tugamagan bo'lsa-da, Marid siz bilan ular tomonda muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramaydi.
achievement.31.name: Marid Ally
achievement.310.description: [EN] Admittedly you enjoyed the killing as usual. But the part with the sparks still gives you shivers ... or is it that there is some charge left on you?
achievement.310.name: [EN] Call Me Sparky
achievement.311.description: [EN] One Bigfoot won over thousands of tiny feet. Perhaps the gnomes are wrong and size matters?
achievement.311.name: [EN] One Foot Vs. Many
achievement.312.description: [EN] The gnomes decided their pigs need some exclusive diet and you had to do all the dirty work - but wasn't the piglet adorable?
achievement.312.name: [EN] The Picky Pig
achievement.313.description: [EN] You killed the ambassador of the abyss that often that they might consider sending another one. Perhaps that will one day stop further intrusions.
achievement.313.name: [EN] Diplomatic Immunity
achievement.314.description: [EN] Have you ever wondered how he reappears again and again? You only care for the loot, do you? Gotcha!
achievement.314.name: [EN] Fall of the Fallen
achievement.315.description: [EN] Again and again Deathstrike has fallen to your prowess. Perhaps it's time for people calling YOU Deathstrike from now on.
achievement.315.name: [EN] Death on Strike
achievement.316.description: [EN] The face of the enemy is unmasked. You have encountered one of 'those below' and survived. More than that, you managed to kill the beast and prove once and for all that the enemy can be beaten.
achievement.316.name: [EN] Death from Below
achievement.317.description: [EN] The fallen gnome is dead and justice served. But what was it that the gnome whispered with his last breath? He's your father???
achievement.317.name: [EN] Gnomebane's Bane
achievement.318.description: [EN] The mighty Deathstrike is dead! One legend is dead and you're on your way to become one yourself.
achievement.318.name: [EN] Final Strike
achievement.319.description: [EN] Seeing a mucus plug makes your heart dance and you can't resist to see what it hides. Goo goo away!
achievement.319.name: [EN] Goo Goo Dancer
achievement.32.description: Garchi Efreet sizni noilojlik bilan kutib oldi va sizni ancha vaqt davomida "faqat inson" sifatida ko'rgan bo'lsa ham, siz Malorni hayratda qoldirdingiz va uning hurmatini qozondingiz va yashil jinlar bilan savdo qilish imkoniyatiga ega bo'ldingiz.
achievement.32.name: [EN] Efreet Ally
achievement.320.description: [EN] Finally your dream to become a walking mushroom has come true ... No, wait a minute!
achievement.320.name: [EN] Funghitastic
achievement.321.description: [EN] If the gnomes had told you that crystal armor is see-through you had probably changed your underwear in time.
achievement.321.name: [EN] Crystal Clear
achievement.322.description: [EN] You have unleashed your inner gnome and slain some of the most fearsome threats that gnomekind has ever faced. Now you can come and go to the warzones as it pleases you. The enemies of gnomekind will never be safe again.
achievement.322.name: [EN] Gnomish Art Of War
achievement.324.description: [EN] You conquered the demon challenge and prevailed... now show off your success in style!
achievement.324.name: [EN] True Dedication
achievement.325.description: [EN] Helping a poor, stupid goblin to feed his starving children and wifes feels good ... if you'd only get rid of the strange feeling that you're missing something.
achievement.325.name: [EN] Task Manager
achievement.326.description: [EN] Assisting Omrabas' sick plan to resurrect made you dig your way through the blood-soaked halls of Drefia. Maybe better he failed!
achievement.326.name: [EN] Gravedigger
achievement.327.description: [EN] You cleansed your soul in serving the Repenter enclave and purified thine self in completing all tasks in a single day of labour.
achievement.327.name: Repenter
achievement.328.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your blade into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.328.name: [EN] Umbral Swordsman
achievement.33.description: Orzular - sizning haqiqatingizmi? G'alati vahiylar, soatlarning taqillatilishi, uxlash va butunlay boshqa joyda uyg'onish - bu qandaydir sayohat edi, lekin siz haqiqatan ham undan zavqlanganingizga deyarli aminmiz.
achievement.33.name: Aniq tush ko'ruvchi
achievement.331.description: [EN] You have helped the gnomes of the spike in securing the caves and explored enough of the lightles depths to earn you a complete cave explorers outfit. Well done!
achievement.331.name: [EN] Cave Completionist
achievement.332.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your slayer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.332.name: [EN] Umbral Bladelord
achievement.333.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your axe into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.333.name: [EN] Umbral Headsman
achievement.334.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your chopper into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.334.name: [EN] Umbral Executioner
achievement.335.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your mace into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.335.name: [EN] Umbral Brawler
achievement.336.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your hammer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.336.name: [EN] Umbral Berserker
achievement.337.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your bow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.337.name: [EN] Umbral Archer
achievement.338.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your crossbow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.338.name: [EN] Umbral Marksman
achievement.339.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your spellbook into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.339.name: [EN] Umbral Harbinger
achievement.34.description: Ko‘pchilik hatto nomini ham bilmaydigan joylarda bo‘lgansiz. Botanika, zoologik va ektoplazmatik namunalarni yig'ish sizning kundalik ishingiz bo'lib, siz doimo yangi ufqlarni kashf etishga tayyormiz.
achievement.34.name: Explorer
achievement.340.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify all kinds of weapons into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world. Respect!
achievement.340.name: [EN] Umbral Master
achievement.341.description: [EN] You collected all of the mysterious bottle messages around the island of Roshamuul and located the remains of the first mate. Time will tell if his tale of mending an evil ring holds true.
achievement.341.name: [EN] Nevermending Story
achievement.342.description: [EN] What a scientific discovery - they really DO communicate! Using their own communication habits against them, you lured a large pack of silencers away from the walls of Roshamuul.
achievement.342.name: [EN] Luring Silence
achievement.343.description: [EN] You did not show any signs of surrender to any sight of... you get the picture. Even a hundred of them did not pose a threat to you.
achievement.343.name: [EN] Never Surrender
achievement.344.description: [EN] You have mended many a broken dream and so, the dream of Roshamuul is safely being told over and over again.
achievement.344.name: [EN] Dream Wright
achievement.345.description: [EN] You have cleansed the lands of many retching horrors. You sure know how to end a bad dream: forcefully, that's how!
achievement.345.name: [EN] Ending the Horror
achievement.346.description: [EN] You know your way, in dream and waking. And how to make tea that transcends the boundaries of conscience.
achievement.346.name: [EN] Sleepwalking
achievement.347.description: [EN] It doesn't matter what noise you would hear... dream, nightmare, illusion - there is nothing you can't vanquish. You are a true Dream Warden.
achievement.347.name: [EN] Dream Warden
achievement.348.description: [EN] Gaz'haragoth... a day to remember! Your world accomplished something really big - and you have been part of it!
achievement.348.name: [EN] Prison Break
achievement.349.description: [EN] After a battle like this you know who your friends are.
achievement.349.name: [EN] Noblesse Obliterated
achievement.35.description: Hatto dushman suv osti muhiti ham Explorer jamiyati oldidagi burchingizni bajarishingizga xalaqit bermaydi. Quara shohligini skaut qilish siz uchun pirojnoe bo'lagidir.
achievement.35.name: Dengiz skauti
achievement.350.description: [EN] Through the spirit of science and exploration, you have discovered how to enter the secret hideout of the renowned Dr Merlay.
achievement.350.name: [EN] Elementary, My Dear
achievement.351.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Commoner.
achievement.351.name: [EN] Rathleton Commoner
achievement.352.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Inhabitant.
achievement.352.name: [EN] Rathleton Inhabitant
achievement.353.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Citizen.
achievement.353.name: [EN] Rathleton Citizen
achievement.354.description: [EN] You accomplished 10 or more consecutive chains in a row! That's killing at least 39 creatures in the correct order - now that's combinatorics!
achievement.354.name: [EN] Combo Master
achievement.355.description: [EN] Though you might have averted a dire threat for Rathleton, this relative peace may only hold for a while. At least you've scavenged an outfit from some of the poor fellows that have fallen prey to death priest Shagron.
achievement.355.name: [EN] Glooth Engineer
achievement.356.description: [EN] You discovered the Lion's Rock, passed the tests to enter the inner sanctum and finally revealed the secrets of the buried temple. You literally put your head in the lion's mouth and survived.
achievement.356.name: [EN] Lion's Den Explorer
achievement.357.description: [EN] Adventure is your middle name. You spent much time in dangerous lands and have seen things others only dream of. You know your way around in Tibia - you are a seasoned adventurer now. And your journey has only just begun!
achievement.357.name: [EN] Seasoned Adventurer
achievement.358.description: [EN] You've got a mind ready to draw strange conclusions that defy the laws of logic and sidestep reality. Or maybe it's just a lucky guess - or adventurous recklessness?
achievement.358.name: [EN] Mind the Step!
achievement.359.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Squire.
achievement.359.name: [EN] Rathleton Squire
achievement.36.description: Voy - bu nima edi? Siz bu erga qanday kelganingizni bilmaysiz, lekin qandaydir tarzda keldingiz. Beregardan Kazordoonga bir zumda qanday borish mumkin - bu mittilar bilishni yaxshi ko'radigan narsa, lekin siz uni qanday ko'paytirishni bilmayapsiz.
achievement.36.name: Pathfinder dargumon
achievement.360.description: [EN] He seriously stored away a wallnut? That was a nutty professor indeed.
achievement.360.name: [EN] The Professor's Nut
achievement.361.description: [EN] You have defeated the wallbreaker and saved the glooth plant.
achievement.361.name: [EN] Plant vs. Minos
achievement.362.description: [EN] You have defeated the tremor worm - and wonder what kind of fish you'd be able to catch with such a bait.
achievement.362.name: [EN] Rumble in the Plant
achievement.363.description: [EN] You have defeated the glooth bomb and chopped down a lot of metal monsters on your way.
achievement.363.name: Robo Chop
achievement.364.description: [EN] You escaped the glowing hot lava death trap, Professor Maxxen has set for you - Captain Caveworm is indeed proud!
achievement.364.name: [EN] Go with da Lava Flow
achievement.365.description: [EN] You saw the Crystal Gardens with all their stunning beauty and survived the equally impressive monsters there. In the end you discovered a great evil and destroyed it with the help of a banshee who was not even aware of her support.
achievement.365.name: [EN] Wail of the Banshee
achievement.366.description: [EN] You are a man of the public. Or of good publicity at least. Through your efforts in advertising the airtight cloth, Zeronex might yet be redeemed - and Rathleton might yet see its first working Gloud Ship.
achievement.366.name: Publicity
achievement.367.description: [EN] By restoring the Everhungry Altar, you charmed the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent back into its fitful sleep, twenty miles beneath the sea.
achievement.367.name: [EN] Snake Charmer
achievement.368.description: [EN] Your adventurous way through countless dragon lairs earned you a pretty treasure - and surely the enmity of many a dragon.
achievement.368.name: [EN] Hoard of the Dragon
achievement.37.description: Issiq, mo'ynali va xushchaqchaq - siz quchoqlagan o'sha ayiq hushida bo'lganida sizni parchalab tashlagan bo'lsa-da, u sizga hali kichkinaligingizda to'shagingizda doimo uxlab yotgan keksa ayiqchani eslatdi.
achievement.37.name: Bearhugger
achievement.370.description: [EN] You found a lost sheep and thus a steady source of black wool. But careful: don't get entangled.
achievement.370.name: [EN] Little Ball of Wool
achievement.371.description: [EN] You made some efforts to bring a little more light into the world. And what a nice present you got in return!
achievement.371.name: [EN] Luminous Kitty
achievement.372.description: [EN] By setting the right tone you convinced a crystal wolf to accompany you. Remember it is made of crystal, though, so be careful in a banshee's presence.
achievement.372.name: [EN] The Right Tone
achievement.373.description: [EN] Having a loyal friend alongside is comforting to every adventurer. If only this lad was not so stubborn...
achievement.373.name: Loyal Lad
achievement.374.description: [EN] It's not really a dragon, but rather a kind of chimera. Nonetheless a decent mount to impress any passer-by.
achievement.374.name: [EN] Dragon Mimicry
achievement.375.description: [EN] The Muggy Plains are a dangerous place, often raided by dragons. But that was your luck: thus you found this scaly little guy.
achievement.375.name: [EN] Scales and Tail
achievement.376.description: [EN] There are many delusions and phantasms in the desert. You saw a false oasis with fruit-bearing palm trees. Instead of water and refreshment, however, you found a dromedary in the end. What a useful Fata Morgana!
achievement.376.name: [EN] Fata Morgana
achievement.377.description: [EN] Finding all the pieces to this complicated vehicle was one kind of a challenge. However, what you built in the end is rather a fabled than a feeble construction.
achievement.377.name: [EN] Fabled Construction
achievement.378.description: [EN] Barking dogs never bite, as the saying goes. But this one clearly tried. In the end, however, you were able to walk the dog - ahem, gnarlhound.
achievement.378.name: [EN] Mind the Dog!
achievement.379.description: [EN] This magnetic beast attracted you in a very literal way. Or was it attracted by your metal equipment? Anyway, you seem to be stuck together now.
achievement.379.name: Magnetised
achievement.38.description: Siz ularni ovlamaysiz, ular bilan gaplashasiz. Bilasizmi, arvohlar uzoq vaqtdan beri tiriklar orasida yo'qolgan sirlarni saqlashi mumkin va siz ularni sizga oshkor qilish uchun gapirishga mohirsiz.
achievement.38.name: [EN] Ghostwhisperer
achievement.380.description: [EN] Counting ten thousand grains of sand could not have been harder than gaining this impressive mount.
achievement.380.name: [EN] Golden Sands
achievement.381.description: [EN] Kingly deer mostly prefer elves as friends and familiars. This one, however, decided to favour you as a confidant and rider. Well done!
achievement.381.name: [EN] Friend of Elves
achievement.382.description: [EN] Finding a four-leaved clover is always a sign of luck. And as luck would have it, you even baited a lovely dotted ladybug. Lucky you!
achievement.382.name: [EN] Lovely Dots
achievement.383.description: [EN] This fiery beast really tried to give you hell. But not even a magma crawler can resist a mug of spicy, hot glow wine. Skol!
achievement.383.name: [EN] Way to Hell
achievement.384.description: [EN] Not really twenty thousand miles, but you had to dive a fair way beneath the sea to find your personal Manta Ray.
achievement.384.name: [EN] Beneath the Sea
achievement.385.description: [EN] By many it is considered a myth like the Yeti. But you came, saw and tamed it. Now you're the proud rider of a midnight panther, black as a starless night.
achievement.385.name: [EN] Starless Night
achievement.386.description: [EN] By mastering the secrets of Lion's Rock, you proved yourself worthy to face the mighty lions there. One of them even chose to accompany you.
achievement.386.name: Lion King
achievement.387.description: [EN] Ah, the old carrot-on-a-stick trick. Well done! You've made the racing bird accept you as a rider and provider. Just don't feed it your fingers.
achievement.387.name: [EN] Pecking Order
achievement.388.description: [EN] Whoa, sow long! This boar is like a force of nature, breaking through the undergrowth of all the Tibian forests and all records of speed. Hang on!
achievement.388.name: Pig-Headed
achievement.389.description: [EN] It might come as a shock to you, but this is the mount of your dreams. Not exactly the white steed of Prince Charming, but maybe the ladies will still scream and faint at the sight of you.
achievement.389.name: [EN] Personal Nightmare
achievement.39.description: Kichkina, zaif hayvonlarga nisbatan yumshoq joyingiz bor va siz ularni himoya qilish uchun qo'lingizdan kelganini qilasiz - hatto nonushta uchun ajdarlarni iste'mol qilsangiz ham.
achievement.39.name: Hayvonlar faoli
achievement.390.description: [EN] It's unstoppable! Walls? Fortresses? Obstacles? Objections? Pah! Nothing will stand before the stampor. Arrows and spears bounce off its hide, enemies are trampled by the dozen. Just don't go for the subtle approach or a date on this thing.
achievement.390.name: [EN] Thick-Skinned
achievement.391.description: [EN] Don't let its fluffy appearance deceive you. The panda is a creature of the wild. It will take you to the most distant regions of Tibia, always in hopes of a little bamboo to nibble on or to check on a possible mate.
achievement.391.name: [EN] Chequered Teddy
achievement.392.description: [EN] Well, you can rest your nailcase now. This gravedigger's fingernails are nice and clean. Though after the next hellride, you might not want to let it hand any food to you.
achievement.392.name: [EN] Blacknailed
achievement.393.description: [EN] Drugging a snail can have some beneficial side effects. You're now the proud owner of a snarling, speed-crazy slug. Maybe it'll purr if you stroke it. Anyway, life should be one slick ride from now on.
achievement.393.name: [EN] Slugging Around
achievement.394.description: [EN] It's a wound-up wooden lizard! Well, stranger things have happened, or so you're told. Just hop on and let this wood-and-tin contraption take you anywhere you want to wind down a bit. And hope you don't get hit by lightning underway.
achievement.394.name: [EN] Knock on Wood
achievement.395.description: [EN] This must be underwater love - this enormous crustacean now does thy bidding. Or maybe it's just in it for a little more of that shrimp barbecue, as that's a little hard to come by in the sea.
achievement.395.name: [EN] Fried Shrimp
achievement.396.description: [EN] What a blast from the past! This thankful patient thinks you missed your dentist vocation. It's now ready to take a bite of the future and to carry you to your next adventure, or your next patient.
achievement.396.name: [EN] Out of the Stone Age
achievement.397.description: [EN] A drop of oil and you're good to go. This unique mount will roll merrily in and out of any strange place you want to visit. If you see no exit, you probably ended up in a circus ring. Ah well, the show must go on!
achievement.397.name: Stuntman
achievement.398.description: [EN] Installing that control unit was a no-brainer. Now you're in control to make it walk this way or that, or to change tack at any moment if required. Your faithful walker mount obeys your every command.
achievement.398.name: Gear Up
achievement.399.description: [EN] Hunter's greeting! Your skillful use of the slingshot actually stunned a large bear. The creature is slightly dazed, but seems susceptible to your commands. Let's declare open season on all our foes!
achievement.399.name: [EN] Bearbaiting
achievement.4.description: Siz har doim isyonchi bo'lgansiz - tan oling! Mahbuslarni ta'minlash, chetlanganlarga g'amxo'rlik qilish, boylardan o'g'irlik qilish va kambag'allarga berish - kutish kerak emas, bu boshqa voqea edi.
achievement.4.name: Qarshilik bilan yashang
achievement.40.description: Siz ayiqlarni quchoqladingiz, mamontlarni itarib yubordingiz va ichish qobiliyatingizni isbotladingiz. Sizda ozgina osilib qolgan, qovurg'angiz qisman singan va tilingizda bir oz yog'li sochlar bo'lsa ham, siz bundan buyon o'zingizni faxriy vahshiy deb atashdan juda faxrlanasiz.
achievement.40.name: Faxriy barbar
achievement.400.description: [EN] 'Sweets for my steed' could be your motto. An impressive horse is eating out of your hand. Saddle up and be ready to find adventure, new friends, and maybe someone to shoe your horse now and then.
achievement.400.name: [EN] Lucky Horseshoe
achievement.401.description: [EN] By cleverly using a leech to cool that raging bull's blood, you managed not to get swamped or trampled in a water buffalo stampede. The creature is now docile and follows your every command.
achievement.401.name: [EN] Swamp Beast
achievement.402.description: [EN] Seems like this spider has got a sweet tooth. As a result, eight hairy legs are now at your disposal to crawl and weave at your whim, and strike fear into the hearts of men.
achievement.402.name: Spin-Off
achievement.403.description: [EN] Here's looking at you, kid. This ancient creature seems to size you up with its brilliant eyes and barely tolerates you riding it. Maybe it thinks you're the defrosted snack, after all?
achievement.403.name: Icy Glare
achievement.404.description: [EN] You succeeded in finding and charting several previously unexplored landmarks and locations for the Adventurer's Guild, you probably never need to ask anyone for the way - do you?
achievement.404.name: [EN] Cartography 101
achievement.405.description: [EN] Lifting the secrets of a fabulous palace and defeating a beautiful demon princess was a thrilling experience indeed. This site's marvels nearly matched its terrors. Nearly.
achievement.405.name: [EN] Lost Palace Raider
achievement.406.description: [EN] It's dangerous to go alone... Take ten friends.
achievement.406.name: [EN] The More the Merrier
achievement.408.description: [EN] You went through hell. Seven times. You defeated the demons. Countless times. You put an end to Ferumbras claims to ascendancy. Once and for all.
achievement.408.name: [EN] Rift Warrior
achievement.41.description: Siz bu erda savollarni qo'yadigan odamsiz va siz eshitishni xohlagan javoblarni qanday olishni bilasiz. Qolaversa, siz mashhur exorcistsiz va u erda va u erda bir nechta vampir va jinlarni o'ldirasiz. Siz va sizning ulushingiz mukammal jamoasiz.
achievement.41.name: Oliy inkvizitor
achievement.410.description: [EN] You sucessfully fought against all odds to protect your world from an ascending god! – You weren't there for the hat only after all?
achievement.410.name: Hat Hunter
achievement.411.description: [EN] You didn't manage to become an ogre chief. But at least you are, beyond doubt, a worthy ogre chef.
achievement.411.name: Ogre Chef
